mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_condition(warehouse_id,sku_id,stock_condition,quantity) VALUES(#{warehouseId},#{skuId},#{stockCondition},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity=quantity
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_condition SET quantity=quantity+#{delta},version=version+1 WHERE warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND stock_condition=#{stockCondition} AND quantity+#{delta} BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
mapper.select: SELECT c.warehouse_id warehouseId,CAST(c.sku_id AS CHAR) skuId,c.stock_condition stockCondition,c.quantity,c.version FROM inventory_condition c JOIN sku s ON s.id=c.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY c.sku_id,c.stock_condition LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_condition c JOIN sku s ON s.id=c.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId}

SELECT o.operation_no,CAST(o.sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id,o.from_condition,o.to_condition,o.quantity FROM idempotency_request r JOIN inventory_condition_operation o ON o.operation_no=r.business_no WHERE r.actor_type='USER' AND r.actor_id=#{actorId} AND r.operation='CHANGE_INVENTORY_CONDITION' AND r.idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} AND r.state='SUCCEEDED' AND o.sku_id=#{skuId}
